title: LDT7808 — Test Mode entry (§3-3)
description: Enter test mode: Power+Start once, then press Start 1–7 to load components.

source.manualTitle: LG LDT7808 Top-Control Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Power on
steps.body: Press Power to turn dishwasher on.

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press Power + Start once (version display n35/U00/D00). Then press Start repeatedly to step through loads: 1=Sump temp/dispenser, 2=Drying fan, 3=Soil sensor, 4=Drain motor RPM, 5=Inlet valve frequency, 6=Wash motor RPM, 7=Heater + Vario valve. Start ×8 powers off. Door must be closed for most steps.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press POWER + START; press Start 1–7 for component loads.
